card.name: Long non-English words in medication text
card.fires_on: Partway through longer non-English words (Spanish, German, Dutch, Urdu, Latin plant names) where the word is split into pieces. It fires on the middle or end piece, not on whole common English words.

modes.label: Spanish and German word pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a long Spanish or German word, often in a name or compound.

modes.label: Rare names and glossary terms
modes.description: A piece of a plant, species or translated term in a list of names or glosses.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long words from other languages, mostly German and Spanish, when the word is split into parts.
